title: Refunds Given in Answer to a Buyer Claim: Pocketwire Business Profile Credit Scaling
content:
The claim-settled refund credit on a Pocketwire Business Profile follows how the refund was made:

- when the seller issued the refund as the response to a not-as-described buyer claim on that sale, the refund percentage credit is multiplied by 0.5 and rounded down to the cent;
- when the refund answered an item-not-received buyer claim on that sale, it is multiplied by 0.75 and rounded down to the cent;
- a refund given without such a claim response keeps the refund percentage credit as it is.

A refund answers a claim when the claim opened on the refunded sale carries a seller response of the "refund issued" kind; the claim's reason is the reason recorded when it was opened.

| Claim on the refunded sale | Seller response recorded | Claim-settled refund credit |
|---|---|---|
| not as described | refund issued | refund percentage credit multiplied by 0.5, rounded down to the cent |
| item not received | refund issued | refund percentage credit multiplied by 0.75, rounded down to the cent |
| unauthorized buyer | refund issued | refund percentage credit as it is |
| any reason | a response of another kind | refund percentage credit as it is |
| no claim | — | refund percentage credit as it is |

**Worked figures (hypothetical refund percentage credit of USD 2.3456).** Not as described: 1.1728, rounded down to USD 1.17. Item not received: 1.7592, rounded down to USD 1.75. No claim response: USD 2.3456 as it is.
